prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use refined warm lifestyle editorial photography: considered light and composition with relaxed believable interaction, never a glossy advertising pose. Three female friends aged 28, 34, and 41 enjoy a small spring flower-arranging workshop around a plain wooden table, choosing tulips and greenery while talking and smiling. Use an elegant environmental composition, gentle window daylight, tactile paper and linen, and clear realistic hands handling a few stems rather than dense overlapping bouquets. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct casting: one female friend has a straight black bob and East Asian features, another has dark skin and natural black curls, and the third has copper-red shoulder-length hair and subtle glasses. All are fictional individuals. Native aspect ratio EXACTLY 16:9. WIDE environmental establishing composition; all three women, faces, heads and important hands must remain within the CENTRAL 55 PERCENT of the image width, with the outer sides showing the workshop.

FINAL COMPOSITION PRIORITY: This is a distant WIDE environmental establishing photograph from 6 metres away with natural 28mm perspective, not a close or medium group portrait. All people and their important working hands are clustered in the MIDDLE HALF of image WIDTH (horizontal coordinates 25%-75%), with complete heads inside the middle 45% of width. The LEFT QUARTER and RIGHT QUARTER show the ordinary room or workspace with no main people. Show generous surroundings, full seated or standing figures, and practical furniture. Preserve native 16:9.
review: Wide editorial flower workshop shows three visibly distinct women, individually holding stems and arranging greenery. Fingers, stems, faces and full standing figures are coherent; all women fit the central half with generous workshop margins. Lower area is continuous furniture and floor. Actual central 4:3 and 1.65 crops were rendered and visually checked: all main heads, key hands and actions remain complete.
